versions.content: function RecoveryAction [SWS_PHM_01149] Upstream: RS_HM_09159 , RS_AP_00159 RecoveryAction ( RecoveryAction &&ra)=delete; The move constructor operator for the RecoveryAction shall not be used. Rationale: Using the move constructor after a RecoveryAction instance has been offered may result in premature invocation of RecoveryHandler before the derived class is fully constructed.
